description: Mint a short-lived OBSERVE-ONLY one-click human preview link, optionally deep-linked to a module or lesson (exact-question links are reserved and currently unavailable — they unlock with the Native Forms read-only adapter). The URL is returned ONLY once; its token is single-use, the opener must be a SIGNED-IN member of the session organization (verified live on every read; a signed-out opener is routed through sign-in and the unconsumed link keeps working), and opening it can never change preview state. Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key. Reuse only for the identical operation.

name: opentrain_lms_share_preview_link
